title: Claude Redesigns Any Room From One Photo
description:
Claude just made interior designers obsolete 😳🛋️

Upload a photo of any room → run /banana → and Claude redesigns it like a pro. Swap furniture, change the color palette, rearrange the whole layout — all for pennies in API costs.

Want the full PDF setup guide + the exact prompts I used for the best results? Follow me and comment "design" and I'll send it straight to you 📩✨

#aitools #interiordesign #claudeai #nanobanana #aiautomation
